conversation_history.content: what do u feel about the product in your current use case

In my current use case, foodpanda could be useful if it can replace the spreadsheet work I do for menu pricing, discounts, and order tracking across restaurant and cloud-kitchen setups. I’d want it to be highly customizable, fast, and support keyboard shortcuts or API access—otherwise it’ll just become another tool adding friction. For Bengaluru operators juggling multiple outlets, the value has to be clear: less manual entry and faster daily decisions.
do u need any feature taht is simple and easily acesible

Yes — I’d need a single, always-visible dashboard for menu changes, prices, discounts, and order status. Everything should be editable in one or two clicks and easily exportable to a spreadsheet, since I still track things manually. If that’s buried in menus or syncs slowly, I’d go back to my current workflow.
You’re welcome. If you need more detail on the restaurant workflow I’d want automated, I’m happy to walk you through it.
